description: This file contains utility methods for configuration handling within the Orleans runtime, including parsing time spans, resolving IP addresses, retrieving local IP addresses, and redacting sensitive information from connection strings.

classes.name: ConfigUtilities
classes.description: A static utility class offering methods for parsing configuration-related data, resolving IP addresses, and redacting connection strings.

methods.name: ParseTimeSpan
methods.description: Parses a string representing a time span with optional units ('ms', 's', 'm', 'hr') into a TimeSpan object.

methods.name: ResolveIPAddressOrDefault
methods.description: Resolves an IPAddress based on subnet, address family, and optional hostname or IP string, returning a suitable network address.

methods.name: GetLocalIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local IP address of the server in the specified address family, optionally filtering by network interface name.

methods.name: RedactConnectionStringInfo
methods.description: Redacts sensitive credential information from a connection string for logging purposes.
